name: Guelder-rose
desc: Guelder-rose (Viburnum opulus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Viburnum opulus, commonly known as the guelder-rose, or guelder rose () and highbush cranberry is a Eurasian and North American species of flowering plant in the family Viburnaceae.
